name: Independent visual-to-KC transfer identifiability gate
question: Can independent adult visual KC-gamma-d input-response and intrinsic measurements jointly bound a numerical sensory-entry hypothesis without using B5/B5.5 spike thresholds?
search_scope: adult Drosophila visual KC gamma-d whole-cell visual evoked voltage/current with identified visual input or aMe12 perturbation
adult visual KC gamma-d input resistance capacitance rheobase threshold and stimulus protocol
direct accessory medulla aMe12 to ventral accessory calyx KC functional optogenetic or patch-clamp measurements
primary-source supplements or public datasets with per-cell electrophysiology and source-cell identity
inclusion: primary experimental paper, primary dataset, or experimentally constrained model with inspectable underlying measurements
explicit adult KC gamma-d or clearly identified visual-KC subtype, or aMe12 direct input test
measured unit, preparation, stimulus/presynaptic protocol, postsynaptic response, cell count and uncertainty where reported
transfer_test: identify source pathway and its spike or stimulation protocol
separate natural visual-response amplitude from per-aMe12-spike or per-contact efficacy
require intrinsic excitability in the matched subtype or a justified linked measurement
test whether uncertainty is narrow enough to choose a falsifiable model value without B5/B5.5 outcome fitting
primary_pass: At least one independent, class-relevant measured or constrained joint transfer envelope covers visual input and KC intrinsic response with units and uncertainty and a defensible mapping to the selected MaleCNS source class; no diagnostic spike threshold or performance fit is used.
primary_fail: No reviewed independent evidence permits that joint numerical mapping; record each missing term and declare sensory entry numerically unidentifiable under the available evidence.
inconclusive: Relevant primary source or dataset is identified but inaccessible or reporting is too incomplete to decide whether the transfer envelope exists.
stop: Report the evidence decision and exactly one next Branch B stage, then stop before any electrical revision.
